name: User Story
title: "[SETUP] Development environment"
labels: setup
-------------

**As a** developer
**I need** to set up the development environment
**So that** I can start building the accounts microservice

### Details and Assumptions

* Use Java 21 + Spring Boot
* Use PostgreSQL database
* Use Git for version control

### Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Given a new developer joins the project
When they follow the setup instructions
Then the application should run locally without errors
```
